description: This file defines the AuditTrail class used to track user operations and actions within the vtiger CRM system. It includes functions for retrieving audit trail headers and entries, as well as properties to hold audit data.

classes.name: AuditTrail
classes.description: A class responsible for tracking user activities and actions for audit purposes within the vtiger CRM system.

methods.name: AuditTrail
methods.description: Constructor that initializes logging and database connection instances.

methods.name: getAuditTrailHeader
methods.description: Returns headers for displaying audit trail information, such as Module, Action, Record ID, and Action Date.

methods.name: getAuditTrailEntries
methods.description: Retrieves audit trail entries for a specific user, with support for pagination and sorting.
